lines: 「H-How did things turn out like this......?!」
It had come out of nowhere.
Gosha Village, which was surrounded by impenetrable mountains, looked like an ordinary rural town, but in actuality, it was the hidden village of the Taimanin.
Contrary to its peaceful appearance, it was a solidly-defended stronghold, with all manner of defensive measures implemented.
Despite that, it had been raided――extremely easily. At the hands (or rather, legs) of “them”.
They had only the strength and intelligence of young children, but
With their overwhelming numbers, they had overrun the fields, stolen food, and abducted Taimanin.
「So our mission is to exterminate them, and rescue the kidnapped Taimanin.」
「I-Is it safe for us to do such a big job just on our own......?」
「There's no choice. Since we were outside Gosha, we're the only Taimanin who haven't taken any damage.」
Shikanosuke and I, who were unharmed because we had happened to be out in the neighbouring town, had received a communication from Asagi-sensei, and were presently heading straight to the rescue.
「Hebiko's among the kidnapped Taimanin too, isn't she......?」
「Yeah. There are a lot of other Gosha Academy students too. Let's get to their nest as quick as we can!」
I remembered the words that Asagi-sensei had uttered in a gloomy voice before we set off.
（No no no! Don't think about anything bad! Anyway, right now, there's nothing to do but hurry and rescue them!）
It was a common fate for Taimanin. While preparing ourselves for the worst-possible outcome somewhere in our minds, we hurried down the mountain road.
「I-Is this cave really their nest? There's no one here, though......」
The cavern that was said to be their “nest” was just filled with an eerie darkness, and had no signs of life.
I could see some kind of staff-like object standing in our path.
When we approached it, it appeared to be a strange art piece. Multiple kunai were dangling off the end of the staff, which was stuck in the ground.
And then, the moment we were distracted by that――
Suddenly, my legs were pulled from behind, and I fell flat on my face.
Standing there before me were a large herd of some kind of octopus-like things. When had they gotten there? They were closely packing the place so as to block the way we came.
「Uwaaaah?! What are these?! They're kind of like Hebiko, though?!」
「Monsters with legs growing straight out of their heads......! These are “them”!!! ――Whoa!」
A large group of octopuses threw themselves upon me, and fully covered my body in the blink of an eye.
「Stop it! Your octopus legs are gross! Uguuuh!!!」
My nose and mouth were covered by their octopus legs, and my consciousness rapidly faded.
（Shit...... To think I'd pass out from a tentacle attack...... Can even I not escape the fate of a Taimanin protagonist......?）
「How? How did things turn out like this......?!」
It had happened out of nowhere. The octopuses that were clinging to me were, one after another, shot, slashed, and slammed to the ground.
And what then appeared was a mercenary-like man, clad in grubby-looking armour.
Deftly wielding a knife and sabre, the man eradicated the huge herd of octopuses that filled the cavern.
「I'm a veteran or...... I mean, just an ordinary octopus slayer.」
「Mind you, don't underestimate an octopus. Those guys are stupid, but they're no fools.」
「Underestimate......? An octopus......? I don't know what you're talking about, but...」
「How'd they get behind us, when it was a straight path the whole way?」
「Is it really a straight path? There are side passages. For instance――」
The man shone a light on the cavern wall, and there was a side path hidden in the rock face there.
「Ahh! You're right! We got distracted by that weird art sculpture and didn't notice!」
「Art, huh? The fact they have that could mean we've got a higher order of species here.」
「Higher order......? Ahh, more importantly, what do we do? Fuuma got taken away by those guys in the confusion!」
The man carefully inspected the side path he had found.
「I see. This is the right path, sure enough. I'm going. You coming with?」
「All right, let's go! Annihilate the octopuses!!」
When they finally arrived in the deepest reaches of the cavern, there were indeed octopuses squirming all across it.
「Uwah! There's so many of them! Gross!!」
Perhaps having sensed the intent to kill them, the octopuses simultaneously let out threatening cries.
「h!! Here they come! Exterminate the octopuses!」
